title: The Picture Caught in an Instant

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Watching an artist paint slowly, a child wonders whether distant people might catch a picture in an instant.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Watching an artist paint slowly, (name1), a child, wonders whether distant people might capture a picture in a single moment, as if catching a reflection.

choices.label: Ask What a Picture Is For.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children imagine pictures of every day, every meal and every smile.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An elder wonders whether so many pictures would make each one feel less special.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The artist says the slow making is part of the joy.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar suggests both kinds might exist side by side.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village agrees that pictures help people remember.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A villager says some memories are better kept only in the mind.
